_comment: Entity Locking Config — terms that MUST remain untranslated in English descriptions

cultural_terms._comment: Greek musical/cultural traditions — use the English transliteration, never translate

inherit_from._comment: These categories auto-lock: venue names and neighborhoods from the DB are never translated

formatting_rules.dates: DD Month YYYY (e.g., '15 March 2026', never '15/3/2026' or 'March 15, 2026')
formatting_rules.currency: EUR symbol before amount (e.g., '15 EUR' or 'EUR 15', never '$15')
formatting_rules.venue_names: Use Latin transliteration of Greek venue names (e.g., 'Stegi Idrimatos Onasi' not 'Onassis Foundation Stoa'). If venue has an established English brand name (e.g., 'Half Note Jazz Club', 'Megaron Athens Concert Hall'), use that.
formatting_rules.neighborhoods: Use established Latin transliterations (e.g., 'Koukaki', 'Exarchia', 'Psyrri', never translate to English equivalents)
formatting_rules.metro_stations: Station name only, no line colors (e.g., 'Thissio metro', never 'Thissio metro on the Green Line')
formatting_rules.artist_names: Latin transliteration of Greek names (e.g., 'Giorgos Dalaras' not 'George Dalaras'). Respect artist's preferred English spelling if known.
